title: Ravana Never Taught Lakshmana
status: DRAFT v1 — CE Yuddha 6.97 and 6.100 read; review before posting
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.108)
avoid: naming who first told the 'dying Ravana teaches Lakshmana' story (sources vary): say only 'later retellings and discourses'
the navel-nectar arrow (that is A53, the follow-up)
gore: the arrow 'pierces the heart' — show light, not wounds
mocking the popular story: it carries a good lesson; we only say where it comes from
verify_note: CE 6.97.2-4: Matali urges the Brahmastra, given by Agastya. 6.97.16-17: it falls on Ravana's chest and pierces his heart. 6.97.20-21: bow falls, prana departs, he falls lifeless from the chariot. 6.97.32: Lakshmana among those honouring Rama. 6.100.11-12: Lakshmana consecrates Vibhishana. No words from Ravana after the arrow; no teaching scene.
caption: Many of us have heard that the dying Ravana taught Lakshmana lessons in statecraft, and that Rama sent Lakshmana to learn from him. In Valmiki's Ramayana, the Brahmastra strikes Ravana's chest, pierces his heart, and he falls from his chariot already lifeless. There are no last words and no lesson. Lakshmana is busy with the victory, and soon crowns Vibhishana king of Lanka. The story of Ravana's last lesson came later.

shots.hi: क्या मरते हुए रावण ने, लक्ष्मण को ज्ञान दिया था?
shots.en: Did the dying Ravana really teach Lakshmana?

shots.hi: वाल्मीकि रामायण, युद्ध कांड, सर्ग सत्तानवे। गतासुर्भीमवेगस्तु नैरृतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः… पपात स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा॥ ये है असली कहानी।

sloka.en: “Lifeless, the mighty lord of the rakshasas fell from his chariot to the ground, like Vritra struck by the thunderbolt.”
sloka.translit: gatāsurbhīmavegastu nairṛtendro mahādyutiḥ, papāta syandanādbhūmau vṛtro vajrahato yathā

shots.sloka_pick: take 3 [solemnly] [expressively]: most pitch movement with the words intact, under the shouting guard

shots.hi: युद्ध लंबा खिंचता है। तब इंद्र के सारथि मातलि, राम से कहते हैं, अब ब्रह्मास्त्र चलाइए।
shots.en: The battle drags on. Then Matali, Indra's charioteer, tells Rama: release the Brahmastra now.
units: तब इंद्र के सारथि मातलि, राम से कहते हैं… अब ब्रह्मास्त्र चलाइए।

shots.hi: वही अस्त्र, जो ऋषि अगस्त्य ने राम को दिया था।
shots.en: The same weapon the sage Agastya had given Rama.
units: वही अस्त्र, जो ऋषि अगस्त्य ने राम को दिया था।

shots.hi: बाण रावण की छाती पर गिरता है, और उसका हृदय चीर देता है।
shots.en: The arrow strikes Ravana's chest, and pierces his heart.
units: [serious] बाण रावण की छाती पर गिरता है… और उसका हृदय चीर देता है।

shots.hi: धनुष हाथ से छूट जाता है, प्राण निकल जाते हैं, और रावण रथ से, निर्जीव, धरती पर गिरता है।
shots.en: The bow slips from his hand, his life-breath leaves him, and Ravana falls from his chariot to the ground, lifeless.
units: धनुष हाथ से छूट जाता है, प्राण निकल जाते हैं…
और रावण रथ से, निर्जीव, धरती पर गिरता है।

units: [serious] एक बाण। [pause] हृदय में। [pause] उसी क्षण मृत्यु।

claims.claim: Matali urges Rama to release the Brahmastra for Ravana's destruction
The weapon had been given to Rama by the sage Agastya
The arrow fell upon Ravana's chest and pierced his heart
His bow fell, his life-breaths departed; he fell from the chariot to the ground, lifeless
Lakshmana joins Sugriva, Vibhishana and others in honouring the victorious Rama
At Rama's command Lakshmana consecrates Vibhishana as king of Lanka
No words from Ravana after the arrow and no teaching of Lakshmana anywhere in the death and aftermath chapters (CE 6.97-6.100)
Opening śloka: “Lifeless, the mighty lord of the rakshasas fell from his chariot to the ground, like Vritra struck by the thunderbolt.”
